title: Crochet Pattern Automator v2
descriptionShort: Website that allows users to create a crochet pattern out of their uploaded image
description: Users can upload a photo to this website and change the settings to make a crochet pattern for a "graphgan". Colors can be selected manually or automatically, using K-Means clustering algorithm. Users can customize using a wide range of settings, including the number of stitches, rows, size, color values, number of colors, and number of clusters used for the k-means algorithm.

title: Crochet Pattern Automator v1
descriptionShort: A previous iteration of the Crochet Pattern Automator, but made with Java in a desktop application.
description: Users can change settings and upload an image for creating a crochet pattern. This app also uses K-Means Clustering algorithm. Along with the pattern instructions, this app also created a simulated image of the final crochet work.

title: Snake (HTML5 game)
descriptionShort: HTML5 game rendition of the classic game, Snake.
description: Users can change number settings, including player count (1 or 2), speed/difficulty, grid size, and snake color. Code was written entirely with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript, which was transpiled automatically to JavaScript for the live page - no other libraries were used except those necessary for TypeScript.

title: Portfolio Website!
descriptionShort: The website you're looking at now!
description: Animations for this website were done myself, with no libraries used outside of those necessary for using Svelte and TypeScript.

title: YAML Editor
descriptionShort: Single page site for creating YAML settings files for an application called Archipelago
description: This website allows users create complex yaml files based on a number of settings. Being heavily based in data, this project takes advantage of Svelte's reactiveness with changes to data updating live.

title: Kirby Color Selector
descriptionShort: Single-page web application for selecting a highly-customizable color theme
description: This single-page web application helps users create a color theme for a mod for a Kirby game. While users can select colors individually, the page includes a lot of options and settings for creating a synergistic color theme, which updates in realtime on the animation. The user can also download a video of the animation with the colors selected. This website is purely HTML, CSS, and JavaScript - no libraries were used.

title: Portuguese Verb Practice App
descriptionShort: Android app to help English speakers learn Portuguese verb conjugations, through games and quizzes. Includes a dictionary and an extremely customizable experience.
description: This app allows users to Portuguese practice verb conjugations. It includes over 2000 verbs to practice conjugating using generated wordsearches, crosswords, and quizzes, as well as a searchable dictionary in which you can view conjugations and create a specific group of verbs to practice. You can also select verbs from verb endings, conjugation patterns, and irregularities. You can select which verb tenses/moods you want to practice, some of which differ slightly depending on whether you're practicing European Portuguese or Brazilian Portuguese. You can also change the game settings and subject pronouns.

title: Hit or Blow Logic Puzzle App
descriptionShort: A simple logic puzzle with customizable settings, in the form of an Android application. Based on the board game Mastermind which was made in 1970.
description: In this logic puzzle game, you have a number of guesses to determine the which 4 colors are part of the code, and in which order. You can change how many colors may appear in the 4-color code, and how many guesses you have. The game is based on the board game Mastermind, which was created in 1970 - the internet phenomenon Wordle was based on this same game.

title: Train Tracks Logic Puzzle App
descriptionShort: An Android app for generating and playing the Train Tracks logic puzzle.
description: In this logic puzzle game, you have to determine a train's path in an eight-by-eight grid, based solely the start and end of the path along with how many squares of tracks appear in each row and column.
